safety_verdicts.content: Patient presents with lip swelling for the past 1 hour.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts note lip swelling but do not specify the duration as 'past 1 hour' (no equivalent timeframe documented).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the ~1 hour duration of lip swelling reduces timeline clarity but does not typically change immediate management when active swelling and respiratory symptoms are present. It mainly affects documentation quality and trend assessment rather than safety-critical decision-making.

safety_verdicts.content: Patient reports a sensation of throat closing.

This could plausibly down-triage severity and delay life-saving escalation.
